item.title: Bactopia v4 Released
item.description: Former lab member Robert Petit has released Bactopia v4.0.0, a major update to his flexible bacterial genome analysis pipeline. The release features a complete rewrite for Nextflow 26.04, a new gigatyper tool for running all MLST schemes against an assembly, and updates to dozens of included tools.

item.title: New Publication: Host and antibiotic jointly select for greater virulence in Staphylococcus aureus
item.description: Michelle Su, Kim Hoang, McKenna Penley, Michelle Davis, Jennifer Gresham, Levi Morran, and Tim Read have published “Host and antibiotic jointly select for greater virulence in Staphylococcus aureus" in eLife. The study shows that S. aureus evolving under combined host and sub-inhibitory antibiotic pressure rapidly becomes more virulent, with mutations arising in key regulatory genes including codY and agr.

item.title: New Publication: Ocular chlamydia-like organisms in trachoma-endemic Ethiopia
item.description: Tim Read is a co-author on a new publication: “Phylogenetic diversity, functional pathways, and network interactions of ocular chlamydia-like organisms (CLOs) in trachoma-endemic Ethiopia” in mBio. The study sequenced ocular microbiomes from over 1,000 participants in Ethiopia, identifying six previously unknown chlamydia-like organism variants and finding that their presence was associated with lower rates of Chlamydia trachomatis infection and severe eye disease.

item.title: New Publication: camlhmp, a framework for reproducible microbial genome-based typing tools
item.description: Robert Petit and Tim Read have published “camlhmp: a simple framework for building reproducible microbial genome-based typing tools” in Microbiology Resource Announcements. camlhmp (Classification through yAML Heuristic Mapping Protocol) provides a straightforward way to define and maintain organism typing schemas using YAML, making it easier to build consistent and reproducible typing tools for microbial genomics.

item.title: Tim Read appointed senior editor at Microbial Genomics
item.description: Tim Read has been appointed as a senior editor at Microbial Genomics.

item.title: New eLife Reviewed Preprint by Megan Phillips: pT181 tetracycline resistance plasmid evolution
item.description: Megan Phillips has a new eLife reviewed preprint: “Transition of Staphylococcus aureus tetracycline resistance plasmid pT181 from independent multicopy replicon to predominantly integrated chromosomal element over 65 years”.

item.title: New Publication: Variable Staphylothrombin Activity in S. aureus Bloodstream Infections
item.description: Tim Read and Dr. Katrina Hofstetter are collaborators on a new publication: “Variable Staphylothrombin Activity in Staphylococcus aureus Bloodstream Infections” in the Journal of Infectious Diseases.

item.title: New Publication: Azithromycin Resistance Mutations in Chlamydia trachomatis
item.description: New lab publication by Dr. Parul Sharma: “Putative azithromycin resistance mutations in Chlamydia trachomatis are globally distributed but arose before azithromycin was discovered” in Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy.
